original_value: As a new extension of a cubic set, the notion of a cubic interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy set is introduced, and its application in     B C K / B C I    -algebra is considered. The notions of    α   -internal,    β   -internal,    α   -external and    β   -external cubic IVIF set are introduced, and the P-union, P-intersection, R-union and R-intersection of    α   -internal and    α   -external cubic IVIF sets are discussed. The concepts of cubic IVIF subalgebra and ideal in     B C K / B C I    -algebra are introduced, and related properties are investigated. Relations between cubic IVIF subalgebra and cubic IVIF ideal are considered, and characterizations of cubic IVIF subalgebra and cubic IVIF ideal are discussed.

result.paraphrase: As an extension of a cubic set, the concept of a cubic interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy set is proposed, and its use in B C K / B C I -algebra is examined. The notions of α-internal, β-internal, α-external, and β-external cubic IVIF sets are introduced, and the P-union, P-intersection, R-union, and R-intersection of α-internal and α-external cubic IVIF sets are studied. The ideas of cubic IVIF subalgebra and ideal in B C K / B C I -algebra are introduced, with their properties explored. The relationships between cubic IVIF subalgebra and cubic IVIF ideal are also considered, along with characterizations of both concepts.
